verdict.rationale: Skyfire is a SaaS identity and payments layer that handles user and agent data, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack covers only tokens, KYA verification, wallets, settlement and the MCP server. Nothing mentions AI training data use, opt-out controls or a data-use policy, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
